tool_args.rationale: The long-horizon observations confirm the predicted transition from positive to negative response. Fit all four parameters numerically and test the resulting law on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its three long-horizon measurements establish the reversal and constrain the slow component.
The eight existing observations span short and long horizons and are sufficient to fit the four-parameter proposed law.
The observed horizon-dependent reversal and the verified adaptation mechanism favor the dual-exponential model; the Ricker law has no horizon dependence.
